description: This file defines the PcbNode class, which represents a node in a printed circuit board (PCB) data structure. It includes methods for parsing PCB node definitions from a string, reading from files, writing node data back to files, and utility functions for managing child nodes and querying node properties.

classes.name: PcbNode
classes.description: Class representing a generic PCB node with parsing, serialization, and manipulation capabilities. It serves as a base for specific node types such as SegmentNode, PadNode, NetNode, etc.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Reads a PCB node structure from a specified file and parses it into a PcbNode instance.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the PcbNode, including its name and number of children.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Static method that parses a string containing PCB node data into a PcbNode or its specific subclass based on the nodeName.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Serializes the PcbNode and its children into a formatted string.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes the serialized node data into a specified file.

methods.name: setDouble
methods.description: Sets a child node's value at specified index to a double value.

methods.name: asDouble
methods.description: Retrieves a double value from a child node at a specified index.

methods.name: hasChild
methods.description: Checks if this node has a child with the specified key.

methods.name: findIfExists
methods.description: Finds a child node with the specified key if it exists.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a unique child node with the specified key, throws exception if multiple found.

methods.name: nodes
methods.description: Returns a list of child PcbNode objects.

methods.name: iterate
methods.description: Returns a list of child nodes matching the given key.

methods.name: addChild
methods.description: Adds a child node to this node.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable list of all child objects.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Returns a specific child as a String at the given index.

methods.name: setString
methods.description: Sets a child's value at specified index to a String.

methods.name: setInt
methods.description: Sets a child's value at specified index to an integer value.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Stub method intended to determine if a PointNode is connected; currently returns false.
